_comment: Who to tell when the Ear covers a place. One entry per venue/organizer, keyed like content/ig-handles.json so a story's social.igTags resolves here too; `match` strings catch untagged stories by their Where/Venue fact. Every email/phone/name here is one the organization PUBLISHES ITSELF (its site, its official socials) and `source` says where — nothing scraped from people-search sites. `to` overrides `email` as the address the weekly note goes to. `introduced` is the date Andy sent the FIRST note himself; until it's set, scripts/venue-notify.mjs only drafts. `salutation` overrides the greeting (default: first name of people[0], else 'Hi <name> team,').

ijams.name: Ijams Nature Center

people.name: Cindy Hassil
people.role: Development Director; named Media Contact on most Ijams press releases (ext. 1006)

people.name: Paige Crane
people.role: Education Director; Media Contact on the Jul 2026 Hummingbird Festival release (ext. 1010)

ijams.notes: No general info@ inbox; publicprograms@ijams.org is the public-programs/events inbox. No marketing/PR role on staff — press releases name Hassil (most often) or Crane as Media Contact, so the note goes to Cindy. President & CEO Amber Parker left Aug 14 2026; CEO search open (start Jan 2027), no interim named on ijams.org as of 2026-09-23.

kerns.notes: kernsfoodhall.com redirects to kernsbakery.com. Contact page is a HubSpot form only; events@kernsbakery.com is the only published address. No events/marketing manager named. Developer/operator Four Stones Group, Atlanta (info@fourstonesgrp.com). Third-party listings show (865) 381-3612 but Kern's doesn't publish it. Also TikTok @kernsbakery.
